title: JEANEE drops her recent track titled “OkOk”
htmlContent:
American-based music star JEANEE is a multi-talented singer and songwriter who captures the heart of his loving fans with his incredible sounds and lovely writing. JEANEE hopes to create something uniquely his while also reflecting elements from the music that inspires him. The talented star does not disappoint in the release of his recent track “OkOk.”

JEANEE “OkOk” is a jersey club pop-rap mix with much energy and a great product. JEANEE displays his incredible pen and maneuvers through this track quickly with eye-popping bars at every turn. Different artists influenced her work from different genres and styles, and he appreciated all art and music.
